_comment: Fork-owned freshness configuration. The runner (tools/spec-freshness.mjs) is
template code and knows nothing about Square; everything vendor-specific is here.
Authoring a new fork's freshness job means writing this file, not a script.

spec.note: Signal only. Nothing in this unit is generated from the spec; see README, 'Not spec-generation-reliant'.

changelog.note: Square publishes no RSS feed for the API changelog; the dated per-version links on the index are the machine-readable form.

notInSpec.GET /oauth2/authorize: The authorization page is a browser redirect flow that Square documents in prose (developer.squareup.com/reference/square/oauth-api/authorize); it is not a REST operation in api.json, so its absence is expected rather than drift.
